items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: I was very sorry to hear about my brother Robert Pass.

ctx.x: Yes, he was. He was the oldest one. And then Robert, the one that died not very long ago. Last... No, I know you don't know him. Well, he never did play music, you see. And then Isaiah, Andrew, and myself.
Can you remember any of the early bands you heard aside from your brother's band?
